Legal & About
Terms of Use

Pocket Footy Manager is a fan-made browser game provided free of charge for personal entertainment. By playing this game you agree that:

  • This game is provided as-is with no guarantees of uptime, data persistence, or future updates.
  • Your game data is stored locally in your browser (localStorage) and is never transmitted to any server.
  • You will not redistribute, resell, or commercially exploit this game or its code without permission.
  • The creator reserves the right to update or discontinue the game at any time without notice.
Disclaimer

Pocket Footy Manager is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with the Australian Football League (AFL), any AFL club, or any official AFL licensee or product.

All team names, player names, and statistics in this game are entirely fictional and procedurally generated. Any resemblance to real AFL players, coaches, or club personnel is purely coincidental.

The terms "AFL", "Australian Football League", and associated club names and trademarks are the property of their respective owners. This game makes no claim to those trademarks.

Copyright

© 2025 Pocket Footy Manager. All original game code, design, and systems are the work of the creator. This is a personal, non-commercial project distributed freely.

This game is not for sale and is not an official AFL product.
